unitTitle: Reported Speech - Reported Statements - Say/Tell - Reported Questions

pairsWith.noteUz: Say/tell va ko'chirma savollar nazariyasi + ko'chirma darak gap mashqlari.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 14-UNIT NAZARIYA DAVOMI + MAShQLAR (67-bet, PDF 66). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '14'.

Och pushti ramka:
'Say - Tell': We use say in direct and reported speech with or without a personal pronoun. 'Tom said, "I need some help." Tom said (that) he needed some help. Tom said to me, "I need some help." Tom said to me (that) he needed some help. (less common)' We use tell with a personal pronoun. We never use to with tell. '"Tom told me (that) he needed some help." (NOT: Tom told to me ...)'
'Reported Questions': • We introduce reported questions with ask or want to know. In reported questions, the verb is in the affirmative and the question mark is omitted. Verb tenses, pronouns and possessive adjectives change as in statements. • When the direct question begins with a question word (who, where, when, why, what etc), the reported question begins with the same word. Direct speech: '"Where do you live?" she asked me.' Reported speech: 'She asked me where I lived.' • When the direct question is a yes/no question and begins with an auxiliary verb (do, be etc) or a modal verb (can, will etc), then the reported question begins with if or whether. Direct speech: '"Have you got a pet?" he asked me.' Reported speech: 'He asked me if/whether I had a pet.'

'Reported Statements':
1) 'Fill in the gaps with the correct pronouns or possessive adjectives, as in the example.' 1 Kevin said, "I have lost my favourite sweater." → Kevin said that he had lost his favourite sweater. 2 Lars said, "My brother is going to drive me to the station." → Lars said that ...... brother was going to drive ...... to the station. 3 Aunt Mary said, "I want you to have dinner with me tomorrow night." → Aunt Mary said that ...... wanted ...... to have dinner with ...... the following night. 4 Heidi said, "I'll buy a new sofa for my living-room." → Heidi said that ...... would buy a new sofa for ...... living-room. 5 Sue and Frank said, "We are going to have a barbecue at our cottage next weekend." → Sue and Frank said that ...... were going to have a barbecue at ...... cottage, the next weekend.
2) 'Turn the following direct sentences into reported speech, as in the example.' 1 "I'll go to the dentist," she said. → She said (that) she would go to the dentist. 2 "I have lived in Montreal for ten years," she said. 3 "We are leaving in June," Dad said. 4 "I forgot to take the dog for a walk," said Annie. 5 "We have done the washing-up," they said. 6 "I always wake up early on Mondays," he said. 7 "The Browns are looking for a new house," she said. 8 "We bought a flat two months ago," he said to Carol. 9 "I'll paint the garage next week," he said to Sam. 10 "I've brought you some flowers," he said to Julie.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '67'.

exercises.instructionEn: We use say in direct and reported speech with or without a personal pronoun: Tom said, 'I need some help.' Tom said (that) he needed some help. Tom said to me, 'I need some help.' Tom said to me (that) he needed some help. (less common) We use tell with a personal pronoun. We never use to with tell: Tom told me (that) he needed some help. (NOT: Tom told to me ...)
exercises.instructionUz: 'Say' to'g'ridan-to'g'ri va ko'chirma gapda shaxs olmoshi bilan yoki olmoshsiz ishlatiladi: Tom 'Menga yordam kerak' dedi. Tom unga yordam kerakligini aytdi. Tom menga 'Yordam kerak' dedi. Tom menga yordam kerakligini aytdi. (kamroq ishlatiladi) 'Tell' HAR DOIM shaxs olmoshi bilan ishlatiladi. 'Tell' bilan hech qachon 'to' ishlatilmaydi: Tom menga yordam kerakligini aytdi. (Tom told TO me ✗)
exercises.explanationUz:
SAY va TELL - FARQI.

  SAY - olmoshsiz (yoki 'to' +
  olmosh):
    Tom SAID (that) he needed help.
    Tom SAID TO ME (that) ...
    (kamroq)

  TELL - HAR DOIM + KIM (to siz!):
    Tom TOLD ME (that) he needed
    help.

  ⚠ ENG KO'P XATO:
    'Tom told TO me' ✗
    'Tom said me' ✗

  QISQAChA:
    said (that) ... / said TO me
    told ME (that) ...

points.en: Tom said, 'I need some help.' → Tom said (that) he needed some help. (say without a pronoun)
points.uz: Tom 'Yordam kerak' dedi. → Tom yordam kerakligini aytdi. (say - olmoshsiz)

points.en: Tom said to me (that) he needed some help. (say + to + pronoun - less common)
points.uz: Tom menga yordam kerakligini aytdi. (said to me - kamroq)

points.en: Tom told me (that) he needed some help. (tell + pronoun, never 'to')
points.uz: Tom menga yordam kerakligini aytdi. (told me - 'to' yo'q)

exercises.instructionEn: We introduce reported questions with ask or want to know. In reported questions, the verb is in the affirmative and the question mark is omitted. Verb tenses, pronouns and possessive adjectives change as in statements. When the direct question begins with a question word (who, where, when, why, what etc), the reported question begins with the same word: 'Where do you live?' she asked me. → She asked me where I lived. When the direct question is a yes/no question and begins with an auxiliary verb (do, be etc) or a modal verb (can, will etc), then the reported question begins with if or whether: 'Have you got a pet?' he asked me. → He asked me if/whether I had a pet.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'chirma savollar 'ask' yoki 'want to know' bilan boshlanadi. Ko'chirma savolda fe'l TASDIQ tartibida bo'ladi va savol belgisi qo'yilmaydi. Zamon, olmosh va egalik sifatlari darak gapdagidek o'zgaradi. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol SAVOL SO'ZI (who, where, when, why, what) bilan boshlansa, ko'chirma savol ham shu so'z bilan boshlanadi: 'Qayerda yashaysan?' deb so'radi u mendan. → U mendan qayerda yashashimni so'radi. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol HA/YO'Q savoli bo'lsa va yordamchi (do, be) yoki modal fe'l (can, will) bilan boshlansa, ko'chirma savol 'if' yoki 'whether' bilan boshlanadi: 'Uy hayvoning bormi?' deb so'radi u mendan. → U mendan uy hayvonim bor-yo'qligini so'radi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA SAVOLLAR - ASKED / WANTED
  TO KNOW.

  ⚠ 3 QOIDA:
  1) So'z tartibi TASDIQ (ega +
     fe'l), 'do/does/did' yo'q
  2) Savol belgisi (?) yo'q
  3) Zamon, olmosh o'zgaradi (darak
     gapdagidek)


1) SAVOL SO'ZI BOR (where, what,
   when, why, who):
   "Where DO YOU LIVE?" she asked.
   → She asked me WHERE I LIVED.
   (do yo'q, tasdiq tartib, lived)

2) HA/YO'Q SAVOLI (do, is, have,
   can, will ...):
   "HAVE YOU GOT a pet?" he asked.
   → He asked me IF / WHETHER I
     HAD a pet.
   (if / whether = -mi, -yo'qligini)


⚠ O'ZBEKChA:

  'qayerda yashashimni so'radi'
  'bor-yo'qligini so'radi'

points.en: Reported questions: ask / want to know; verb in the affirmative; no question mark
points.uz: Ko'chirma savol: ask / want to know; tasdiq tartibi; savol belgisi yo'q

points.en: 'Where do you live?' she asked me. → She asked me where I lived. (question word)
points.uz: 'Qayerda yashaysan?' → U mendan qayerda yashashimni so'radi. (savol so'zi)

points.en: 'Have you got a pet?' he asked me. → He asked me if/whether I had a pet. (yes/no question)
points.uz: 'Uy hayvoning bormi?' → U mendan uy hayvonim bor-yo'qligini so'radi. (ha/yo'q savoli)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct pronouns or possessive adjectives, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'g'ri olmosh yoki egalik sifati bilan to'ldiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLMOShLAR O'ZGARIShI.

  1 I → he; my → his (NAMUNA)
  2 My → his; me → him
  3 I → she; you → me (aytilgan
    odam - men); me → her
  4 I → she; my → her
  5 We → they; our → their


⚠ 'YOU' → 'ME':

  Meri xola 'you' deb menga
  aytgan - ko'chirmada 'me'.

items.textEn: Kevin said, "I have lost my favourite sweater." → Kevin said that ___ had lost ___ favourite sweater.
Lars said, "My brother is going to drive me to the station." → Lars said that ___ brother was going to drive ___ to the station.
Aunt Mary said, "I want you to have dinner with me tomorrow night." → Aunt Mary said that ___ wanted ___ to have dinner with ___ the following night.
items.hintUz: I → she; you → me; me → her
items.whyUz: ⚠ Meri xola - ayol: she, her; 'you' (men) → me.

items.textEn: Heidi said, "I'll buy a new sofa for my living-room." → Heidi said that ___ would buy a new sofa for ___ living-room.
Sue and Frank said, "We are going to have a barbecue at our cottage next weekend." → Sue and Frank said that ___ were going to have a barbecue at ___ cottage, the next weekend.

exercises.instructionEn: Turn the following direct sentences into reported speech, as in the example. 1 'I'll go to the dentist,' she said. → She said (that) she would go to the dentist. 2 'I have lived in Montreal for ten years,' she said. 3 'We are leaving in June,' Dad said. 4 'I forgot to take the dog for a walk,' said Annie. 5 'We have done the washing-up,' they said. 6 'I always wake up early on Mondays,' he said. 7 'The Browns are looking for a new house,' she said. 8 'We bought a flat two months ago,' he said to Carol. 9 'I'll paint the garage next week,' he said to Sam. 10 'I've brought you some flowers,' he said to Julie.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gaplarni ko'chirma gapga aylantiring, namunadagidek. 1 'Tish shifokoriga boraman,' dedi u. → U tish shifokoriga borishini aytdi. 2 'Monrealda o'n yildan beri yashayman,' dedi u. 3 'Iyunda ketamiz,' dedi dadam. 4 'Itni sayrga olib chiqishni unutdim,' dedi Enni. 5 'Idishlarni yuvib bo'ldik,' deyishdi ular. 6 'Dushanba kunlari har doim erta turaman,' dedi u. 7 'Braunlar yangi uy qidirishyapti,' dedi u. 8 'Ikki oy oldin kvartira sotib oldik,' dedi u Kerolga. 9 'Keyingi hafta garajni bo'yayman,' dedi u Semga. 10 'Senga gul olib keldim,' dedi u Juliga.
exercises.explanationUz:
ZAMON BIR QADAM ORQAGA + OLMOSh +
  VAQT SO'ZI.

  1 will → would (NAMUNA)
  2 have lived → had lived
  3 are leaving → were leaving
  4 forgot → had forgotten
  5 have done → had done
  6 wake up → woke up
  7 are looking → were looking
  8 bought → had bought; two
    months ago → two months
    before; said to Carol → told
    Carol
  9 'll paint → would paint; next
    week → the following week
  10 've brought you → had
     brought her; said to Julie →
     told Julie

  ⚠ 'said to X' → 'told X' (yoki
  'said to X' qoladi).
exercises.exampleEn: 1 She said (that) she would go to the dentist.
modelAnswers: 1 She said (that) she would go to the dentist.
2 She said (that) she had lived in Montreal for ten years.
3 Dad said (that) they were leaving in June.
4 Annie said (that) she had forgotten to take the dog for a walk.
5 They said (that) they had done the washing-up.
6 He said (that) he always woke up early on Mondays.
7 She said (that) the Browns were looking for a new house.
8 He told Carol (that) they had bought a flat two months before.
9 He told Sam (that) he would paint the garage the following week.
10 He told Julie (that) he had brought her some flowers.
modelAnswersUz: 1 U tish shifokoriga borishini aytdi. (NAMUNA - will → would)
2 U Monrealda o'n yildan beri yashashini aytdi. (have lived → had lived)
3 Dadam iyunda ketishlarini aytdi. (are leaving → were leaving)
4 Enni itni sayrga olib chiqishni unutganini aytdi. (forgot → had forgotten)
5 Ular idishlarni yuvib bo'lishganini aytishdi. (have done → had done)
6 U dushanba kunlari har doim erta turishini aytdi. (wake up → woke up)
7 U Braunlar yangi uy qidirishayotganini aytdi. (are looking → were looking)
8 U Kerolga ikki oy oldin kvartira sotib olishganini aytdi. (bought → had bought; ago → before)
9 U Semga keyingi hafta garajni bo'yashini aytdi. (next week → the following week)
10 U Juliga unga gul olib kelganini aytdi. (you → her)

patterns.exampleEn: Tom said that he needed some help. Tom told me that he needed some help.
patterns.exampleUz: Tom yordam kerakligini aytdi. Tom menga yordam kerakligini aytdi.

patterns.formula: KIM + asked + KIMDAN + SAVOL SO'ZI + EGA + O'TGAN ZAMON
patterns.exampleEn: 'Where do you live?' → She asked me where I lived.
patterns.exampleUz: 'Qayerda yashaysan?' → U mendan qayerda yashashimni so'radi.

patterns.formula: KIM + asked + KIMDAN + if / whether + EGA + O'TGAN ZAMON
patterns.exampleEn: 'Have you got a pet?' → He asked me if I had a pet.
patterns.exampleUz: 'Uy hayvoning bormi?' → U mendan uy hayvonim bor-yo'qligini so'radi.

patterns.formula: 'I'll + FE'L + next week,' he said to X. → He told X (that) he would + FE'L + the following week.
patterns.exampleEn: 'I'll paint the garage next week,' he said to Sam. → He told Sam that he would paint the garage the following week.
patterns.exampleUz: 'Keyingi hafta garajni bo'yayman,' dedi u Semga. → U Semga keyingi hafta garajni bo'yashini aytdi.
